questions.question: Explain the role of timing resistor and capacitor in IC 566.
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the role of timing resistor and capacitor in IC
  • 566. Function of 566
  • - (1 Mark) Role of timing resistor
  • - (2 Marks) Role of timing Capacitor
  • - (2 Marks) The IC 566 is a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) that generates a square wave and a triangular wave. Its frequency of oscillation depends on an external timing resistor and timing capacitor, along with the applied control voltage. Role of Timing Resistor : ● The timing resistor determines the charging and discharging current of the external capacitor. ● This current sets how fast the capacitor voltage rises and falls between the two threshold voltages inside the IC. ● A higher R means lower charging current → lower frequency, while a lower R gives higher frequency. Role of Timing Capacitor (C) : ● The timing capacitor stores and releases charge during the oscillation cycle. ● Its charging and discharging time (through R) determines the oscillation period. ● Increasing C increases the charge/discharge time, thus decreasing the frequency of oscillation.
